QF.id: SIA Logic Model for Social Programs_47

question.text: Ms. Sunita Patil has signed an AIR whose LFM fails basic SMART tests at both outcome and output levels. Per the current SIA workbook (pp.59, 126), which body has primary oversight jurisdiction over her conduct as an SIA?

answer.text: The Institute of Social Auditors of India (ISAI) under the aegis of ICAI, or any other SEBI-specified SRO (such as ICMAI SAO or ICSI ISA), with which the SIA is registered
ICAI SIAB (Social Impact Assessment Standards Board)

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the current SIA workbook (p.59) and definitions (p.126), Social Impact Assessors register with an SRO under ICAI or another SEBI-specified agency. The workbook names the Institute of Social Auditors of India under ICAI, and the broader framework recognises ICMAI SAO and ICSI ISA as SEBI-specified SROs. Disciplinary oversight runs through the SRO the SIA is registered with. The Trap: "ICAI SIAB" is a common distractor that reflects an older labelling; the current workbook frames the SRO as ISAI under ICAI (or other SEBI-specified agencies). RBI and IRDAI regulate banking and insurance respectively. Cross-Exam Context: NISM XXIII Ch 2 (Ecosystem) and Ch 7 (SAS) both test SRO oversight; current SEBI Master Circular (January 19, 2026) on SSE confirms the SRO landscape.
